specs.prompt: Production-ready painted isometric fantasy RPG sprites matching the attached approved four-region concept. Match Morningstar Town craftsmanship: warm cream limestone, detailed weathered oak framing, individually painted blue slate or terracotta roof tiles, restrained greenery and fine material detail. Orthographic isometric 30 degree elevated view, front and right wall visible, identical camera and scale, neutral soft daylight from upper left. ONE SQUARE high-resolution transparent atlas in a strict 2 by 2 equal grid. Four entirely separate complete isolated objects, one centered in each cell, 14 percent empty transparent margin around every object and wide empty gutters. Keep every roof, blade, tree branch and base inside its own cell. Genuine alpha-zero background. No captions, letters, HUD, watermark, ground tile, floating island, perspective horizon, cast shadow, bloom or aura. Shadows and night lighting will be provided by the engine. No pre-lit bright windows. Do not include any neighboring buildings or large scenery behind a sprite. TOP LEFT: A cozy single woodland cottage with blue slate roof, cream stone base, oak timber framing, modest cream awning, herb planters, stacked logs and a clearly visible wooden entrance. No surrounding forest. TOP RIGHT: An ancient mossy stone shrine ruin, two broken tall arches around a small open court, carved lintel, subtle ivy and a clear walk-through front entrance. Compact recognizable silhouette, not an intact house. BOTTOM LEFT: A small circular limestone moon well with still pale blue water, low carved rim, two slender partial pillars, tiny trailing flowers. No tree, no huge arched building, no glow. BOTTOM RIGHT: A handsome working windmill with a slender cream stone tower, terracotta cap and FOUR intact wooden sails, compact attached timber millhouse, sacks and a low step at its visible entry. Wheat fields will be separate game objects.
